_comment: Town houses (early game) and the Widow's Crossing outpost (mid game). Costs: marks + items. hours = build time.

storage.name: Storage Shed
storage.desc: Secure storage for your goods. Raiders find less to steal.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.desc: Anvil, furnace and workbench. A worker smelts ore from storage each day.

farm.name: Farm Plot
farm.desc: Plant seeds; harvest in 3 days. A worker replants and harvests for you.

well.name: Well
well.desc: Fresh water: fills flasks and keeps workers watered.

bunkhouse.name: Bunkhouse
bunkhouse.desc: Beds for you and your people. Each bunkhouse houses 4 workers or guards.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: Lookout and archers' post. +18 defense; raids are spotted early.

training.name: Training Yard
training.desc: Dummies and sparring ring. Assigned companions train combat skills daily.

trading.name: Trading Post
trading.desc: Caravans stop here. A worker earns marks daily (Trading skill, Caravan standing).

stockade.name: Stockade
stockade.desc: A walled yard with cells and a cookhouse. Holds 4 prisoners in decent conditions; they warm to you faster than in a cellar.

fortification.name: Fortification
fortification.desc: Walls and towers give 50% more defense.
